root_text: @cremechic11 The NHS has seen a rise in flu-like admissions in recent weeks, up to 5,000 leading into the new year. I think it’s the HMPV virus.

nodes.author: ChiomaChuka
nodes.text: @_thecapitaine @cremechic11 A hospital in our area started redirecting patients to other Trusts because they were overwhelmed with the number of patients presenting flu-like symptoms. My consultation was virtual because my practice was advising people not to come in at all. Hopefully it lifts soon.

nodes.author: _thecapitaine
nodes.text: @ChiomaChuka @cremechic11 It’s now complicated with kids now back in school.

nodes.author: ChiomaChuka
nodes.text: @_thecapitaine @cremechic11 Yep! Little people are the harbingers of sickness 😭 My mother says that when we were young, it seemed my siblings and I would hold out baskets to collect whatever sickness was in season. All the poxes, measles, you name it, one of us caught it and brought it home 🤣
